description: Delete Blocklist Entry by ID - Delete ONE blocklist entry by its ID (no lists or bulk input). Only entries added by hand (add_to_blocklist or the app's CSV upload) can be deleted; entries created by an unsubscribe, a bounce, an API sync and older entries cannot. The address can be emailed again afterwards, so the user must approve it. Returns a preview first; the action runs only when called again with the returned confirmation_token after the user has approved the preview.

confirmation_token.description: Leave out on the first call. After the user has approved the preview, pass the confirmation_token that call returned.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: delete_blocklist_entry

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.
